{{Quote|We return to primal darkness as one, Jedi! To join our brothers and sisters in Chaos!|Fomadu, to Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="Lone Wolf" />}}
'''Fomadu''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bpfasshi/Legends|Bpfasshi]] [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] who lived during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Chaos take the Jensaarai! And Chaos take you! Fomadu and I follow a new way! No Jedi and Sith. No light or dark. Just the truth of this instant of life."<br />"And upon ending your life, we will suckle your youngling on the teat of that truth, which the babe will recognize or be destroyed.|Mei and Fomadu, to Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="Lone Wolf" />}}
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], during the Clone Wars, the Bpfasshi were [[Bpfassh Uprising|defeated]] by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] forces led by [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]].<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> The same year, several key members of the [[Jensaarai/Legends|Jensaarai]] cult, known conspirators with the Bpfasshi, were [[Duel on Susevfi|killed]] on [[Susevfi]] by Jedi [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Nejaa Halcyon]] and [[Ylenic It'kla]]. On the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malo VI]], Fomadu joined forces with [[Mei (Dark Jedi)|Mei]], whose father, [[Sukarr]], was killed by Kenobi on Susevfi. She saved Fomadu from committing suicide in the wake of his brother [[Zukao]]'s [[Death/Legends|death]], and he transferred the [[Force-bond]] he had shared with his Bpfasshi sibling to her. In return, Fomadu gave her purpose, while their new master, a mysterious [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Unidentified cyborg master|cyborg]], gave them hope. The cyborg and his followers worshipped the [[Chaos|Great Void]], which, they believed, was the only truth, as there was no the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark side]] nor the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|Light side]].<ref name="Lone Wolf" />

Later, Fomadu and Mei tracked down two [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]], [[T'ra Saa/Legends|T'ra Saa]] and [[Tholme/Legends|Tholme]], to [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], to kill them for their role in slaughtering the Bpfasshi. However, they found Obi-Wan Kenobi there instead, who went to Nar Shaddaa after his [[Duel on Mustafar/Legends|duel]] with [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to sell the [[Soulless One/Legends|Soulless One]] before travelling to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] with newborn [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. Two Dark Jedi tried to chase Kenobi down. Fomadu finally caught up with Kenobi in the waste shaft and they started dueling. During the [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]], Fomadu's fleet blade intercepted Obi-Wan's kill stroke, bashing [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's third lightsaber/Legends|the lightsaber]] aside. Obi-Wan instantly grabbed Fomadu's lightsaber-wielding wrist, and they started grappling. As the Jedi was still weak and tired after his duel with Vader, Obi-Wan allowed Luke's singular Force signature to course into him and reached for an image, protected at the edge of the Bpfasshi's mind. Then, for one brief moment, Obi-Wan created a [[Mind trick/Legends|Force illusion]], turning himself into Fomadu's fallen brother, Zukao. Fomadu was startled for a moment, and Kenobi bent back the darksider's wrist, thus [[Sai cha/Legends|beheading]] the Bfasshi with his own lightsaber.<ref name="Lone Wolf" />
